## History

Miss Patty Spofford is an unmarried woman who inherited her charming house, Patty's Place, from her brother [Aaron](../character/aaron.md). Living there with her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md), she agreed to rent the home to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) for their upcoming school year. After finalizing the rental agreement, she yielded the house to the young women, who subsequently moved in and established their household alongside their friends and cats.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P0](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0000), [v3 ch.Park P1](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0001), [v3 ch.Park P2](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0002), [v3 ch.Park P3](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0003), [v3 ch.Park P4](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0004), [v3 ch.Park P5](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0005), +105 more_

## Quotes

> "They are over a hundred years old, and they have sat on either side of this fireplace ever since my brother Aaron brought them from London fifty years ago. Spofford Avenue was called after my brother Aaron."
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025)

> "Their names are Gog and Magog. Gog looks to the right and Magog to the left. And there’s just one thing more. You don’t object, I hope, to this house being called Patty’s Place?"
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030)

> "I shall leave the dogs where they are, if you will promise to be very careful of them"
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030)

> "And now, wouldn’t you like to go over the house and see it all before we consider the bargain made?"
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032)

> "I intended to take that sign down today."
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P4](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aaron--patty.md)

[Aaron](../character/aaron.md) is Patty Spofford's brother. His sister Miss Patty, along with her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md), arranged to rent their home, Patty's Place, to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends for the school year. His family's decision to let the house allowed [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her companions to establish their new household.

- Sibling of — brother  <sub>[v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025)</sub>

### [Maria](../character/maria.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

[Maria](../character/maria.md) is Patty's niece and traveling companion. Together, they made the arrangements to rent Patty's Place to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) for the upcoming school year before going abroad. Their departure enabled [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her college friends to move in and settle into the house.

- Comrade of — traveling companions abroad  <sub>[v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007)</sub>
